scope: Figure 10 habit-ventilation and Figure 13 IGF2+ numerical outputs; prescribed-air reconstruction and laboratory duration controls.

paper.reading: Sections 2.1, 4.1, 4.2; Table 1; Equation 4; Figure 10 and 13 captions. No claim of a fresh complete-paper review.
paper.author_settings: Constant water saturation; initial spherical radius 2 micrometres; ten-minute endpoint comparison.
paper.equation_control: Equation 4 uses L^2 Dv es/(Ka Rv^2 T^3); pinned source uses (L/(Rv T)-1)*L Dv es/(Ka Rv T^2). Leading-term controls retain all other source choices, including unequal vapour/heat ventilation when enabled.

author_data.credit: Welss, J.-N., Siewert, C., and Seifert, A.; McSnow paper data and plot scripts.
author_data.external_bytes_policy: Full external archive remains ignored; derived target values retain attribution in the result.
author_data.encoding: Nine comma-separated fixed-decimal values. Eight plotting names cause pandas to use the first elapsed-time field as index.

pressure.basis: Filename p1010.0 interpreted as hPa; original driver not recovered.

timestep.basis: Filename dt1.0; original integrator configuration not recovered.

author_data.axis_mapping: a and c are semiaxes, verified by D=2 max(a,c), phi=c/a and V=4*pi*a^2*c/3 within printed rounding. Both axes doubled for the project full-axis convention.
author_data.plot_mapping: fig10.py and fig13.py display native a,c in micrometres, mass in micrograms, and apparent density clipped at 919 kg/m3. Raw and clipped density retained separately.
author_data.averaging: Each selected row is an endpoint; no ensemble/output averaging is specified or applied.

plot_scripts.reading: Data-file selection, implicit-index convention, axis/mass conversion and density clipping; scripts read, not executed.

native_source.reconstruction: Native 2024 code and tables, existing custom caller with optional native saturation. Four separately identified candidate builds; no baseline source edits.

historical_hint.text: for old bugged version (reproduce paper) comment these two lines
historical_hint.interpretation: Disable the two local Dv/Ka multiplications only. The source comment does not identify an exact figure/version.

public_history.examined: Pinned public tree, deposition-file commit history, mo_check.f90, archived plot scripts and numerical member inventory.
public_history.missing: Original generating single-crystal driver, complete namelist, exact revision-to-figure mapping and executable were not found in these artifacts.

declared_caller_choices.seed_mass: Native ice density times spherical volume.
declared_caller_choices.air_density: Native Rd/Rv with ideal moist-air mixture in the custom caller.
declared_caller_choices.saturation: Native psat_water(T) imposed exactly; separate inherited Murphy-Koop controls.
declared_caller_choices.growth_variants: IGF1 and revised IGF2plus mapped to native growth_mode 1 and 2; mapping remains a reconstruction pending archive agreement.
declared_caller_choices.initial_state_probe: Use author-rounded mass,V,phi; reconstruct full axes from V and phi. Compare time zero speed, before any growth.
declared_caller_choices.rounding_probe: Eight corners of independent printed half-rounding box in mass,V,phi for each selected thin-plate state; a sampled sensitivity, not a proved continuous bound.

laboratory.scope: Published Table 2 mass/full-axis and Table 4 speed fits at ten temperatures, restricted to recorded 3-minute-to-end-age windows.
laboratory.limits: Fits summarize different crystals; pointwise uncertainty absent; thin-planar thickness inferred from mass/area. No early observed sphere history and no independent empirical density curve reconstructed here.

comparison_policy.author_match: Every compared field inside its printed decimal half-rounding interval.
comparison_policy.numerical: Report last-pair refinement changes separately; compare residual with rounding plus last change as a diagnostic only.
comparison_policy.held_source: Native source and historical two-operation sensitivity remain separate; leading-thermal-term changes are separately named.
comparison_policy.population_boundary: Prescribed-air isolated crystal calculation; no finite-water, storm or lunar validation inferred.

storage.rule: Use lexical checkout paths for runners; original snow cache paths remain symlinks. External source bytes, build and raw execution files stay ignored.
